testcase.name: Scenario: Export an unapplied custom ribbon command: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1327:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Export an unapplied custom ribbon command ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and an initially empty Part Tools target ✔ And 2D Sketches has been staged with Large and Text unchecked ✔ And the target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user exports customization to a new XML file ✔ Then the export chooser closes ✔ And the customization dialog still shows 2D Sketches in the target list ✔ And the target still shows a pending-change marker ✔ And the exported settings do not contain the staged 2D Sketches command in Part Tools ✔ When the user clicks Cancel in the customization dialog ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
